full_judgment:
37. It is conveniently observed that, though sad, yet it is a fact that in our country there is a tendency on the part of people to rope in as many people as possible for facing trial in respect of murderous onslaught perpetrated upon any victim. It has been found that innocent person including aged, inform, rivals including political rivals are booked for standing on dock. Some are acquitted by Court of First Instance and some by Appellate Court but only having been in incarceration for years. Such efforts on the part of relatives of victim and other interested persons invariably, but unfortunately, help real culprit or culprits as it becomes difficult on the part of Court/ Tribunal to sift grain from the chaff. Under such circumstances and in view of prevalent Criminal Jurisprudential System Doctrine of presumption of innocence in favour of accused makes justice system a victim which ultimately weakens Criminal Justice Dispensation System. 

 97. A duty is cast upon prosecution to explore every avenue open to it to unveil truth. Witnesses who can throw sufficient light in unfolding truth are to be produced before witness box as prosecution witnesses. Non-examination of material witnesses shall give rise to a strong presumption against prosecution case in respect of involvement of an accused in the felony allegedly committed by him. If a material witness who would unroll the genesis of incident is not brought to fore otherwise or where there is a gap or infirmity in the prosecution case which could have been supplied or provided by examining a witness who is not examined, prosecution case can be termed as suffering from a serious deficiency and infirmity and withholding of such a material and vital witness would oblige the Court to draw an adverse inference against the prosecution by holding that if the witness would have been examined he would not have supported the prosecution case as projected.
